subject.title: fix(agents): handle stdout stream errors in shell snapshot runShell

question: Should maintainers converge this stdout-pipe fix on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100744, or ask this PR to be revised independently before either branch lands?
rationale: Both PRs target the same current-main shell-snapshot stdout pipe failure, but the apparent cleaner PR is still open without sufficient real behavior proof, so cleanup automation cannot safely close this one as superseded.

options.title: Converge On Existing Repair
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100744 as the canonical branch once its proof and CI gates are resolved, then close or supersede this PR with that evidence.

options.title: Revise This Branch
options.body: Ask this PR to remove the OS-signalling test side effect, add production-path coverage, and provide real shell-snapshot or host-exec proof before merge.

options.title: Keep Both Temporarily
options.body: Leave both PRs open until one has clean proof and maintainer approval, accepting short-term duplicate review overhead.

recommendation.title: Converge On Existing Repair
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100744 as the canonical branch once its proof and CI gates are resolved, then close or supersede this PR with that evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc already pushed the same-root maintainer repair on the cleaner open PR, making them the best available owner for the canonical-branch decision.
